messages:
maria: Heads up — prod embeddings spike, ~4% 5xx across EU region since 02:43. I have a small revert branch that fixes the KV cache edge-case. Need expedited approval to push a hotfix that is rollback-safe. Deploy bot will require 2 approvers.
release-bot: Deploy request queued for service=embed-consumer, commit=abc1234. Canary plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 5m observation windows. Approvals required: 2. Rollback policy: automatic on error >1% or latency >200ms sustained 2m unless manual override.
kevin: ack, can stand by for approvals. Is there any data migration?
maria: no migrations. Pure runtime change, tiny binary. Rollback is immediate (traffic reweighted back).
oncall-joe: oncall-joe: I'm oncall for the window, I'll monitor traces and SLI. +1 from me if infra is good.
jon: quick question — does this touch the async ingest path? If so we should watch queue depth.
maria: it affects the cache path only. Ingest path unchanged. queue depth unaffected.
sarah: sarah: can we get a short release note blurb? I'll update the changelog once this lands.
maria: release notes draft: "Revert KV cache micro-optimization that caused intermittent 5xx on high-concurrency requests. Restores stability for embed-consumer." Link: https://go.internal/releases/2026-03-12-hotfix (internal)
kevin: kevin: infra +1. Please pin the routing to v2026.03.12-hotfix during deploy. Also, run the deploy command below when ready:
```
# deploy command
/deploy embed-consumer v2026.03.12-hotfix --canary=10 --step=5m --pin-routing=true
```
release-bot: release-bot: Approval step pending. To approve, react or run `/approve 7135792001`. Approvals so far: oncall-joe.
jon: jon: /approve 7135792001 — monitoring from my side.
release-bot: release-bot: Approvals received: oncall-joe, jon. Starting canary at 10%. Canary start time 7135792028.
release-bot: release-bot: Canary 10% -> health checks ok (error rate <0.1%, p95 latency normal). Advancing to 30%.
kevin: kevin: watching infra metrics — no abnormal spikes.
release-bot: release-bot: Canary 30% -> stable. Advancing to 100%.
release-bot: release-bot: Deploy complete to 100% at 7135792055. Routing pinned to v2026.03.12-hotfix.
maria: maria: thanks everyone — observed error rate back to baseline. Rolling notes and will close incident.
sarah: sarah: posting changelog now and will send the release note to #release-notes. :thumbsup: 
kevin: kevin: :thumbsup: great job.
release-bot: release-bot: Deployment summary: service=embed-consumer, commit=abc1234, duration=4m, result=success, rollback not triggered.
maria: maria: leaving a quick follow-up — I'll run a 1h post-deploy evaluation job to validate long-tail traces. If anything crops up ping me directly.
